name: Team Vyoma
description: We are the Aeromodelling Club of RV College of Engineering, dedicated to researching, designing, building, and flying high-performance RC aircraft. We work across aerodynamics, structures, propulsion, electronics, and flight systems, turning engineering concepts into real, functional aircraft. We actively participate in major national-level aeromodelling competitions at institutions such as IIT Bombay, IIT Madras, JSS Mysuru, and other leading engineering colleges, constantly challenging ourselves to develop more advanced, efficient, and high-performance aircraft. Through every project and competition, we aim to push our technical capabilities, innovate with new designs and technologies, and establish ourselves as one of the leading student aeromodelling teams in the country.

events.name: Build, Balance & Fly
events.detail: Participants will design and manufacture an RC aircraft while applying principles of aerodynamics, structures, propulsion and flight control. The challenge is to transform their design into a functional aircraft capable of successful flight.

events.name: Know Your Skies: Aviation Quiz and debate challenge
events.detail: A fast-paced quiz and debate that tests participants’ knowledge of aircraft, aviation history, aerospace technology, flight systems and famous aviation milestones. Participants will compete through multiple rounds that challenge their knowledge, memory and quick thinking.

events.name: Flight Detective: Black Box Investigation
events.detail: Think you can solve an aviation mystery? 🕵️‍♂️✈️ Step into the shoes of a flight investigator and uncover what really happened during a simulated aircraft incident. Decode black box data, analyse flight parameters, connect the clues, and piece together the events leading up to the crash. With unexpected twists, technical challenges, and plenty of detective work, Flight Detective is where aviation meets mystery — and your job is to find the truth before the evidence takes you in the wrong direction!

events.name: Take the Controls: Flight Simulator Challenge
events.detail: Step into the cockpit and put your piloting skills to the test! Take the Controls is an exciting flight simulator challenge where participants take control of a virtual aircraft and navigate through realistic flying scenarios. From smooth takeoffs and precise turns to handling unexpected obstacles and landing safely, every decision counts. Test your reflexes, accuracy, and understanding of flight.
